name: New Hampshire
agencyName: New Hampshire Division of Motor Vehicles

gdl.permitMinAge: 15 yrs 6 mo (supervised practice; NH does not issue a separate learner's permit card)
gdl.nightCurfew: No driving 1 a.m.-4 a.m. (youth operators under 18)
gdl.passengerLimits: For the first 6 months, no more than one passenger under 25 who is not family, unless a licensed adult 25+ is in the front seat; never more occupants than seat belts

requiredDocuments: Proof of identity and date of birth (e.g. certified birth certificate or U.S. passport)
Proof of New Hampshire residency (two documents for a REAL ID)
Proof of legal presence if not a U.S. citizen
process.realIdNotes: New Hampshire issues REAL ID-compliant licenses. Bring proof of identity/date of birth, Social Security Number, and two proofs of New Hampshire residency. A REAL ID is optional; a standard license is also available.
process.permitFee: No fee for the supervised-driving permit paperwork; driver education is required for under-18 applicants
process.licenseFee: $50 for a 5-year Class D or youth operator license ($10 per year)

facts.pointSuspensionThreshold: Suspension may follow: under 18, 6/12/18 points in 1/2/3 calendar years; under 21, 9/15/21; age 21+, 12/18/24
facts.moveOverRule: Move over a lane, or slow down if you cannot move over, for stopped emergency, maintenance, and highway response vehicles with flashing lights
facts.interstateMaxSpeed: 65-70 mph (70 mph on posted rural interstate segments)
facts.schoolZoneSpeed: Reduced when posted and children are present (commonly 10-25 mph); obey posted school-zone signs
